integration.name: Fulcra Flow State v2 metadata provenance

license.boundary: The contribution was rebased onto the upstream revision carrying the repository-level MIT license. This records the published upstream license; it is not independent legal advice.

implementedCapabilities: Explicit opt-in is required before session or marker audio is read or hashed.
SHA-256 digests bind the session, marker and selected clip without embedding audio bytes or local paths.
The deterministic metadata record binds the marker boundary, extraction window, processing version, key and BPM estimates, and the MusicalIdea reference.
The optional sharing record omits full-session and marker digests and binds a hashed audience reference.
The implementation verifies canonical record integrity and refuses private sharing by default.

privateSessionValidation.boundary: This publishes only the participant-authorized sanitized completion state. Audio, consent references, record digests, Fulcra paths, upload identifiers and the full private result remain outside the repository and public artifact.

nonClaims: This is not a Fulcra partnership, endorsement, certification or security assessment.
This does not attest Fulcra access enforcement or alter the Flow State upload pipeline.
This does not establish creative ownership, marker accuracy, key accuracy or BPM accuracy.
This does not prove that a human musical performance was processed; the completed private validation used original synthetic tones.
This is not evidence of customer adoption or commercial validation.
claimBoundary: The merged pull request proves that the bounded metadata-provenance contribution was accepted into the upstream Fulcra community repository at the identified commit. A separately authorized private synthetic-audio session verified one marker-to-MusicalIdea Fulcra round trip and the metadata-only provenance record; it does not establish a human performance result, production deployment, partnership, endorsement or commercial outcome.
